seo.title: Clacky — A Self-Tape Partner That Reads the Other Parts
seo.description: Self-tapes for iPhone and Apple Watch with a friend in it. Clacky, a little clapperboard, reads every part you're not playing, holds your line up by the lens, claps you in and gives you notes after every take. Paste, photo or scan your sides. Video or audio only. Export MOV, MP4, M4A or WAV. Free, no account, nothing leaves your phone.
